task: Eighteen sensors in cold stores, greenhouses, offices and server rooms report every 15 minutes, and the readings reach the platform as a stream: some hours late, some twice, a few impossible. Build the streaming pipeline that checks each reading against the device registry, keeps a health table per sensor, raises one alert per episode, and explains each error the gateway logged. Then prove that when the alert sink fails mid-stream, a restart from the checkpoint delivers every alert exactly once.
problems: Readings arrive late, some by up to 12 hours.
Readings delivered two or three times with the same reading_id.
Payload values or the whole firmware record missing on some readings.
Sensor glitches: a temperature of 999.0 or a humidity of 255.0, which raised false alerts on the platform.
Temperature-only sensors never report humidity; that missing value is expected.
One sensor moved, so it has two location rows.
revenue: A breach is a reading above or below a rule's threshold. The team wants one event per episode: a breach raises an event only when it is more than an hour newer than the newest breach already seen for that sensor and rule. A glitch is never a breach; each glitch raises its own sensor-fault event.

artifacts.name: stream_parsed
artifacts.about: What the stream wrote after reading every batch file.

artifacts.name: validate_readings
artifacts.about: Each reading with its sensor type, its site on that date and its first problem.

artifacts.name: stream_validated
artifacts.about: The validation, run on the stream.

artifacts.name: device_health
artifacts.about: Readings, incomplete readings, glitches, hottest temperature and lowest battery per sensor and 6 hours.

artifacts.name: breaches
artifacts.about: One row per usable reading and rule it breaks.

artifacts.name: anomaly_events
artifacts.about: One event per episode, and one per glitch, from the stateful stream.

artifacts.name: incident_summary
artifacts.about: Every gateway device error with its cause, evidence and false alerts.

artifacts.name: recovery_run
artifacts.about: The alert stream through a failing sink: one row per run, before and after the restart.
